_doc: Round 5 paint-over for back at 80 (r5_paint.py). Seeded from round 4's head layers (art/rosace/overrides/drive9/back_80.json) moved by the head-skin offset R4u -> R5xu (0, 0), then re-authored for the round-4 critics' face and hair fixes. Layers with port: true are also painted on the twin build (R5u).

layers.name: eye_near
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'an iris of deep indigo on top, desaturated blue in the middle and a 1 px pale lower catchlight; drop the pure cyan'. At 80 the eye keeps round 4's 3-4 row shape (a 2-row lash block would close it); the palette takes the 144 eye's ramp: D (was #86b8ee cyan) is now the pale desaturated #8ea6d2, B/C the muted blues.

layers.name: eye_far
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'an iris of deep indigo on top, desaturated blue in the middle and a 1 px pale lower catchlight; drop the pure cyan'. At 80 the eye keeps round 4's 3-4 row shape (a 2-row lash block would close it); the palette takes the 144 eye's ramp: D (was #86b8ee cyan) is now the pale desaturated #8ea6d2, B/C the muted blues.

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: Attractiveness 3: the asymmetric smile, far corner lifted.

layers.name: tail_tips
layers.why: Body critic (round 4, arms and hands 6): 'the free hand is a detached blue claw at the hip'. It is the hair tail's azure tips by the glaive hand (the back view). Inside the hip box they take the hair's own violet ramp by value rank (the tips higher up keep the azure, DESIGN's identity).

layers.name: fist
layers.why: as idle_80 fist: the back view's glaive hand at wrist_left (27.4, 43.9), the cuff toward the elbow (33.9, 51.1).
